statement: The complement of the quartic discriminant in real projective coefficient space RP14 has six connected components, one for each topology in Table 1: four ovals, three ovals, two nonnested ovals, one oval, two nested ovals, and empty. Their real bitangent counts are 28,16,8,4,4,4.

answer.text: 6 chambers: four ovals; three ovals; two nonnested ovals; one oval; two nested ovals; empty
answer.display: 6 chambers: four ovals; three ovals; two nonnested ovals; one oval; two nested ovals; empty
answer.qualification: Real-line counts 28,16,8,4,4,4 respectively in smooth real quartic coefficient space.

scope: Real bitangent lines to a smooth real plane quartic; tangency points may be real or a complex-conjugate pair.
notes: These are smooth-quartic parameter chambers, not chambers separating contact-point reality within a fixed topology. Attribution in the paper is to Zeuthen and Klein.
